title: Hold a petroleum title to explore for or recover petroleum offshore
what: Exploring for petroleum in a Commonwealth offshore area needs a petroleum exploration permit or other authority under the Act.

laws.title: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Act 2006

sources.title: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Act 2006
sources.quote: 97 Prohibition of unauthorised exploration for petroleum in offshore area (1) A person commits an offence if: (a) the person explores for petroleum; and (b) the exploration occurs in an offshore area.

administration.who: Joint Authority (the Commonwealth Minister and the responsible state or territory Minister)

sources.title: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Act 2006
sources.quote: • Generally, the administration of this Act in relation to an offshore area of a State is the responsibility of the Joint Authority for the State.

sources.title: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Act 2006
sources.quote: • The National Offshore Petroleum Titles Administrator is responsible for: (a) assisting and advising the Joint Authority and the responsible Commonwealth Minister;

sources.quote: Other matters (9) NOPSEMA must publish on NOPSEMA’s website a copy of a notice under paragraph (1)(a) or (3)(a).
